scientific_integrity: All formulas have a self-contained combinatorial proof and executable independent finite checks; no external independent audit or publication-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The scalar optimum is elementary and is not asserted new. Exact counts concern only minimum sets on simple cycles, not all feasible sets or general graphs. Full text of the 2017 origin paper could not be inspected, leaving a literature-priority risk. Finite checks support but do not replace the infinite proof.
title: Exact optimal double vertex-edge domination census of cycles
